programme.title: 2026 MotoJunior FIM W. C'ship
programme.desc: 2026 MotoJunior FIM World Championship menjadi panggung bagi calon bintang balap motor dunia. Para pembalap muda menunjukkan kemampuan, konsistensi, dan strategi balapan bersama tim-tim junior terbaik dalam upaya menembus ajang Moto3 hingga kejuaraan dunia yang lebih tinggi.

programme.title: King George VI & QE Stakes 2026
programme.desc: King George VI & QE Stakes 2026 menghadirkan kuda-kuda pacu terbaik dunia, joki papan atas, dan pelatih ternama di Ascot. Menguji kombinasi kecepatan, stamina, dan strategi balapan, ajang Group 1 ini menjadi salah satu sorotan utama kalender pacuan kuda internasional.

programme.title: WPBL S2, Mumbai Highlights
programme.desc: WPBL Musim 2, Mumbai Highlights menghadirkan kembali aksi-aksi terbaik, penampilan pitcher yang impresif, pukulan-pukulan bertenaga, dan pertahanan spektakuler dari seri Mumbai. Tayangan ini memperlihatkan perkembangan kualitas kompetisi bisbol profesional putri yang semakin kompetitif.

programme.title: Faultless, Ep 4
programme.desc: Faultless, Episode 4 menghadirkan tantangan yang semakin berat bagi para tokoh ketika ambisi pribadi berbenturan dengan rahasia lama yang mulai terbongkar. Aliansi tak terduga dan konflik emosional membawa cerita menuju titik balik yang menentukan.

programme.title: Emirates Great Britain Sail GP
programme.desc: Emirates Great Britain SailGP menghadirkan tim layar internasional yang bertanding menggunakan kapal F50 dengan spesifikasi yang sama. Kerja sama kru, strategi menghadapi arah angin, dan manuver presisi menjadi kunci untuk meraih kemenangan sekaligus mengumpulkan poin penting dalam klasemen SailGP.

programme.title: Visit Qatar Sussex Stakes 2026
programme.desc: Sussex Stakes merupakan pacuan kuda Group 1 yang menjadi bagian dari Glorious Goodwood Festival. Perlombaan ini berlangsung di Goodwood Racecourse, Chichester, Inggris, dan diikuti oleh kuda-kuda pacu terbaik dari berbagai negara.

programme.title: 2026 The Asian Tournament
programme.desc: 2026 The Asian Tournament. Pegolf terbaik dari Asia dan berbagai negara bersaing di lapangan yang menantang dengan mengandalkan akurasi, konsistensi, dan strategi permainan untuk memperebutkan gelar juara serta poin penting peringkat dunia.

programme.title: Red Bull MotoGP Rookies Cup
programme.desc: Seri balap motor yang diperebutkan oleh pembalap motor muda yang sedang naik daun, yang belum memiliki pengalaman dalam Grand Prix Sepeda Motor sebelumnya.

programme.title: 2026 FIA TCR World Tour
programme.desc: 2026 FIA TCR World Tour menghadirkan persaingan ketat antara juara berpengalaman dan talenta baru di lintasan yang menantang. Aksi saling salip, strategi balapan, dan konsistensi menjadi faktor penting dalam perebutan poin kejuaraan.

programme.title: 2026 MotoGP Of Germany
programme.desc: 2026 MotoGP of Germany berlangsung di Sirkuit Sachsenring, Jerman, mempertemukan para pembalap terbaik dari Ducati, KTM, Aprilia, Yamaha, dan Honda. Karakter lintasan yang teknis menuntut kemampuan menikung, strategi ban, dan konsistensi tinggi dalam perebutan poin penting kejuaraan dunia.

programme.title: SailGP: Racing On The Edge
programme.desc: Nantikan emosi, teknologi canggih, dan drama luar biasa saat para atlet elit menerbangkan katamaran bersayap sayap yang canggih dalam perlombaan jarak dekat yang mendebarkan di berbagai tempat ikonis di seluruh dunia.

programme.title: 2026 MLB: LAD Vs BRS
programme.desc: Pertandingan LAD vs BRS merupakan bagian dari musim reguler Major League Baseball. Kode LAD mengacu pada Los Angeles Dodgers, sedangkan singkatan BRS bukan merupakan kode resmi tim MLB, sehingga lokasi pertandingan bergantung pada identitas lawan yang dimaksud.

programme.title: Teasing Takagi-San S3, Ep 1
programme.desc: Pada episode pembuka musim ketiga, Nishikata kembali berusaha mengalahkan Takagi dalam berbagai tantangan sederhana, mulai dari latihan kekuatan genggaman tangan, membandingkan kulit yang terbakar matahari, hingga momen-momen di awal semester baru. Namun, kecerdikan Takagi selalu membuat Nishikata menjadi sasaran godaan yang menghibur. Di balik persaingan yang penuh canda, keduanya perlahan menunjukkan kedekatan yang semakin berkembang, menghadirkan kisah romantis remaja yang hangat dan penuh humor.

programme.desc: Seorang istri yang sakit parah bekerjasama dengan asisten rumah tangganya untuk membunuh sang suami yang kasar. Namun, hal ini menyebabkan serangkaian kejadian mengerikan.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh yang kecewa menerima satu serangan terakhir dengan harapan dapat menggunakan penghasilannya untuk mengembalikan penglihatan seorang penyanyi yang secara tidak sengaja dibutakannya.

programme.title: The Emperor And The Minister
programme.desc: Kaisar Qianlong bukanlah penerus takhta yang sah sejak lahir, tetapi ia baru mengetahui kebenarannya saat dua anggota senior organisasi rahasia anti-pemerintah menghubunginya beberapa tahun kemudian.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Nyonya Xu melihat seorang gadis kecil bermain sendirian di pintu masuk dari jauh setiap hari. Ia dengan hangat mengasuh gadis itu, lalu mengadopsinya dari orang tuanya yang tak memedulikannya.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Film mengesankan yang diangkat dari kisah klasik Perjalanan Ke Barat ini menampilkan interpretasi nan unik yang dibumbui dengan humor, aksi laga dan kisah fantasi.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: Tiga gadis pergi ke Jepang untuk mengambil warisan yang tak terduga dan bertemu tiga pria dengan niat yang sama. Pertarungan sengit pun terjadi untuk memperebutkan warisan tersebut.

programme.title: Big Times For Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Sekelompok pemuda dusun yang kocak kembali untuk ke-tiga kalinya! Ah Niu sedang mengerjakan urusannya saat sekantong berlian jatuh dari langit, dan kejadian ini hanyalah awal dari serangkaian kesialan!

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: Ling Yun berperan sebagai pemain pengganti yang disewa oleh sebuah band populer setelah pemain drum mereka yang egois mengundurkan diri untuk bergabung dengan band saingan mereka.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: Film ini menampilkan bakat tari yang jarang terlihat dari pendekar wanita ternama, Cheng Pei-Pei, yang berperan sebagai salah satu dari tiga gadis yang berjuang mencapai puncak kepopuleran.

programme.title: The Champion
programme.desc: Seorang guru bela diri yang baru saja dipenjara bekerja sama dengan seorang wanita yang dizalimi untuk mengalahkan saudara laki-laki pria tersebut, seorang baron batu bara yang memerintah sebuah kota kecil dengan tangan besi.

programme.title: Lady General Hua Mu-Lan
programme.desc: Kisah legendaris yang bercerita tentang keberanian dan kepahlawanan ini dibintangi oleh Ivy Ling Po yang berperan sebagai Mulan, gadis yang bergabung dengan tentara dan menjadi pahlawan sejati bagi warga Tiongkok.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: Seorang hakim berusaha menyelamatkan seorang wanita tak bersalah yang secara keliru dituduh melakukan pembunuhan.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan ski. Kemudian, teman sekamarnya, Yoshio, menikahi istrinya serta mewarisi seluruh kekayaannya. Namun, segalanya berubah sejak Yoshio bertemu seorang pria tua di pemakaman Tamotsu.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Petualangan aksi di mana formula obat penyembuh kanker dicuri, dan tim petarung kung-fu harus mengatasi saingan dan pengkhianatan untuk mendapatkannya kembali.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Seorang aktor berusaha meyakinkan sesosok wanita untuk berperan sebagai Samantha dalam film Bewitched yang dibuat ulang. Namun, ia tidak menyadari bila wanita itu ternyata benar-benar seorang penyihir!

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, putra dari pengusaha yang culun, mendapat kekecewaan usai mencari jodoh di Hawaii bersama temannya. Kemudian, secara tak sengaja mereka terjebak dalam sebuah pertukaran identitas yang kacau.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Pergantian rezim di Leka memicu konflik di dunia hitam & putih. Polisi mengirim Zheng Zha menyusup ke geng Song Bang, tanpa tahu pihak lain sudah siap membalas dendam.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: Seorang pemuda tiba di kota untuk bekerja dengan teman mendiang sang ayah. Ketika toko pewarna mereka dibakar oleh seorang pemimpin geng setempat, ia memutuskan untuk melawan demi melindungi dan menyelamatkan toko.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Cho yang multitalenta ingin belajar dari Dewa Judi dan menghubungi muridnya. Mereka diserang oleh seorang bos kriminal yang berencana menyalahgunakan nama baik Dewa Judi untuk menghasilkan jutaan.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: Seorang wanita diperkosa dan dibunuh selama Perang Dunia II. Empat puluh tahun kemudian, ia kembali untuk menghantui para penganiayanya dari Rumah Besar Tao Tao. Seorang profesor dan keluarganya pindah ke rumah itu, hanya untuk kemudian roh-roh tersebut mengambil putra mereka.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Valentino adalah penipu ulung yang bertemu dengan Kwan, sesama penipu. Bersama-sama, mereka menyamar sebagai berbagai orang dan menciptakan berbagai skema untuk menghasilkan uang. Sementara itu, para gangster sedang menyusun skema mereka sendiri.

programme.title: (Subbed) A Family United : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'A Family United', tells the story of the Singh brothers; lifelong Manchester United fans who have followed the club through every twist of its Premier League journey. From the glory years under Sir Alex Fergsuson to the highs and lows that followed, the brothers relive the moments, memories and matches that shaped both their lives and their bond as a family.

programme.title: Review
programme.desc: Review covers all the action from Matchweek 8, starting with the early kick-off between Nottingham Forest and Chelsea, moving on to Fulham's home clash with Arsenal at Craven Cottage, and concluding with the weekend's headline fixture: Liverpool versus Manchester United.

programme.title: Martin Keown : PL Moments
programme.desc: With over 300 appearances for Arsenal, Martin Keown is an iconic figure at the North London club. A member of the Invincibles, Keown was a graduate of the Arsenal academy before moving to Aston Villa and then Everton before returning to Highbury. A three-time Premier League champion, Keown sits down with PL Moments to talk us through his remarkable journey and select his top ten moments from throughout his time in the Premier League.

programme.title: The Great North London Divide : PL Stories
programme.desc: Set against one of the most dramatic seasons in recent memory, we explore the enduring intensity of the North London rivalry between Arsenal and Tottenham Hotspur. We trace the origins of a feud shaped by geography, identity and decades of defining moments. We interweave the story of this season, which has reshaped the balance of power in North London and brings a fresh perspective to a rivalry already steeped in history. Through iconic matches and unforgettable characters, we capture what this rivalry has meant; and what it could become, as the two clubs look ahead to an uncertain future that may yet see them competing in very different circumstances.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Ars) : Review Of The Season
programme.desc: As we wave goodbye to another action-packed and compelling Premier League campaign, Review of the Season takes you through the twists and turns of a gripping last 10 months. From how the title was won, the fight for European spots, and the battle to avoid relegation - all the key moments are covered from another scintillating season.

programme.title: (Subbed) Diogo Jota : PL Stories

Through interviews with friends, teammates and coaches from Portugal to the Premier League, we look back on Jota's journey, the impact he had on those around him, and the legacy he left behind both on and off the pitch.

programme.title: PL Masterclass
programme.desc: Some of the Premier League's biggest stars take us onto the pitch to discuss the techniques and thought processes that allow them to perform at the highest level. Featuring Brian Brobbey, Alex Scott, Jeremy Doku and Bruno Fernandes.

programme.title: 2025/2026 (Haaland) : Goals Of The Season
programme.desc: From free-kicks to solo runs, scissor kicks to 30-yard screamers, Goals of the Season revisits some of the most memorable strikes from the 25/26 campaign, whilst paying homage to the Golden Boot winner.

programme.title: The Ipswich Way : PL Stories
programme.desc: From the trailblazing success of Sir Alf Ramsey's league champions to Sir Bobby Robson's unforgettable FA Cup and UEFA Cup triumphs, this is the story of one of English football's most cherished clubs. We celebrate the remarkable highs, the resilience through changing times, and George Burley's extraordinary achievements in guiding Ipswich Town to a fifth-place finish in their first Premier League season. As a new chapter begins with Gary O'Neil following the successful reign of Kieran McKenna, we explore how the spirit, identity and ambition of Ipswich Town continues to shape its future.

programme.title: Norwich, The Nearly Men : PL Stories
programme.desc: We take a trip down memory lane to revisit the incredible story of Norwich City's unforgettable 1992-93 season; the campaign that saw an unfancied side come within touching distance of becoming the first-ever Premier League champions. Through interviews with the players and staff who lived it, we relive the pressure, drama and defining moments of a nerve-shredding title battle with Manchester United that could have changed English football history forever.

programme.title: Soaring Seagulls : PL Stories
programme.desc: 'Soaring Seagulls' tells the incredible story of Brighton & Hove Albion; from the brink of collapse and years in the lower leagues to becoming one of the Premier League's smartest and most admired clubs. Featuring interviews with the key figures behind Brighton's rise, alongside celebrity fans who followed every twist along the way, this documentary charts a remarkable journey of survival, ambition and one of the greatest comebacks in modern football.

programme.title: Hair Brained
programme.desc: Eli Pettifog adalah remaja berusia 14 tahun dengan kecerdasan luar biasa yang berhasil diterima di sebuah universitas bergengsi. Namun, kecemerlangan akademis tidak membuatnya mudah beradaptasi dengan lingkungan baru yang dipenuhi mahasiswa dewasa. Di tengah rasa kesepian, Eli menjalin hubungan unik dengan Leo Searly, seorang profesor nyentrik yang tengah berusaha membangun kembali kariernya. Persahabatan keduanya berkembang menjadi perjalanan penuh humor dan pelajaran hidup tentang penerimaan, impian, persahabatan, serta arti menemukan tempat yang tepat dalam kehidupan.

programme.title: The Prince & Me 3: Honeymoon
programme.desc: Enam bulan setelah pernikahan mereka, Raja Edvard dan Ratu Paige meninggalkan kesibukan kerajaan untuk menikmati bulan madu di wilayah Belavia yang indah. Namun suasana romantis berubah ketika mereka menemukan rencana licik seorang pejabat yang ingin mengeksploitasi wilayah tersebut demi kepentingan pribadi. Di tengah intrik politik, pengkhianatan, dan berbagai tantangan, pasangan kerajaan ini harus bersatu melindungi Belavia sekaligus membuktikan bahwa cinta, kepercayaan, dan kerja sama mampu mengatasi setiap rintangan.

programme.title: Mad Genius
programme.desc: Mason Wells, seorang programmer berbakat dengan pemikiran yang tidak biasa, berhasil mengembangkan teknologi revolusioner yang memungkinkan manusia terhubung dalam dunia bawah sadar yang sama. Penemuannya menarik perhatian pihak-pihak berpengaruh yang ingin memanfaatkan teknologi tersebut demi kepentingan mereka sendiri. Ketika batas antara realitas dan dunia pikiran semakin kabur, Mason harus menghadapi konspirasi, ancaman, dan pertanyaan mendalam mengenai kesadaran, kebebasan, serta dampak dari sebuah inovasi yang melampaui batas kemampuan manusia. Mad Genius memadukan fiksi ilmiah, thriller psikologis, dan misteri dalam sebuah kisah yang penuh ketegangan.

programme.desc: Sebuah eksperimen pembangkit energi panas bumi yang gagal membangkitkan kekuatan dahsyat dari dalam perut bumi, memicu badai api dan aktivitas seismik yang mengancam sebuah kota. Di tengah kekacauan tersebut, ilmuwan Eve Carter berusaha menemukan cara menghentikan bencana sekaligus menyelamatkan keluarganya dari kobaran api yang terus meluas. Dengan aksi menegangkan, ledakan spektakuler, dan perlombaan melawan waktu, Firequake menghadirkan kisah perjuangan bertahan hidup menghadapi kekuatan alam yang tak terkendali.

Dipenuhi hasrat balas dendam setelah mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian saudaranya, amarah Mick memicu kerusuhan hebat saat ia melakukan pelarian berani dari Blok Mati 13.

programme.title: Bukan Preman Bener Tapi Beneran Preman
programme.desc: Aldo yang diperankan oleh Ridho Illahi itu bersama dua kawannya langsung masuk ke arena rumah hantu tanpa mau membayar. Tentu Qia (Indah Nicole) kesal dan memarahi para preman itu. Mereka pun terlibat perang mulut. Akhirnya setelah teman-teman Qia datang, para preman pergi. Sementara itu, Akdo yang mempunyai pacar, tiba-tiba diputuskan oleh pacarnya karena si pacar tidak mau jika si Aldo masih menjadi preman. Ternyata keberadaan pasar malam tersebut membuat konflik antara bapak Aldo yang merupakan preman sebenarnya hingga ia bertekad akan menutup pasar malam tersebut. Beberapa kejadian terjadi yang akhirnya mendekatkan Aldo dengan Qia hingga timbul rasa suka di antara keduanya.Padahal, Aldo mempunyai kekasih. Lantas bagaimana kelanjutan kisahnya?

Hidupnya berubah setelah bertemu Alisa, wanita misterius yang membawa keberuntungan, membantunya sukses dalam penjualan. Zaki kemudian memenangkan kompetisi melawan sahabatnya, Yudi, yang ternyata adalah saudara tirinya dan dalang di balik kesialan Zaki. Ketika Alisa diculik oleh Intan karena cemburu, terungkap bahwa Yudi adalah otak di balik penculikan tersebut. Intan akhirnya menyesali perbuatannya dan merelakan cinta Zaki dan Alisa.

programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Cinta Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Vino ini sehari-hari menghantui seorang gadis cantik yang diicarnya. Dikisahkan juga, Vino menjadi korban sebuah pertikaian asmara, yang menyebabkannya meninggal dunia. Anehnya tiba-tiba Vino memakai jaket klub naga dan membuat gadis itu merasa ketakutan.Namun seiring cerita, Vino terus saja membantu gadis tersebut untuk mendapatkan keselamatan dan keamanan. Sampai suatu hari, si gadis masuk rumah sakit, dan sahabat serta ibunya berkata, bahwa gadis itu selama ini berhalusinasi tentang keberadaan Vino atau cowok yang selama ini membantunya.

programme.title: Di Depan Dukung, Di Belakang Nikung
programme.desc: Riska (Rina Diana) yang kabur dari rumah, tertabrak oleh seorang supir minibus yang bernama Arya (Vicky Nitinegoro). Ketika sampai di rumah Arya, Riska mencari alasan untuk bisa tinggal di rumahnya.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Main Api Jadi Main Hati Bestie
programme.desc: Kisah cinta Tasya (Naomi Zaskia) dan Bryan (Arya Vasco) tak pernah berjalan mulus. Tasya kaget ketika Bryan repost foto dengan Avril (Allya Syakila). Tasya akan ke Jakarta dan berencana mengagalkan pertunanga merek. Apakah pasa akhirnya mereka akan bersatu? atau menyerah pada keadaan?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naura: Suara Dari Mas Kambing
programme.desc: Gadis cantik bernama Naura (Ina Marika), yang sepertinya punya keajaiban. Apapun sumpah yang terucap dari mulutnya, pasti jadi nyata. Namun rupanya keajaiban sumpah itu mendadak hilang ketika Naura jatuh cinta sama seorang tukang kambing bernama Satria (Rezca Syam)

programme.title: Dead Trigger

programme.title: Don't Suck

programme.title: Mission: Impossible

programme.title: The Green Hornet

programme.title: Minority Report

programme.title: Food That Built World S5, Ep 8
Hidden Cities Extreme S1, Ep 3
programme.desc: Musim pertama Hidden Cities Extreme mengikuti Simon Yin menjelajahi berbagai negara di Asia untuk mencoba langsung pengalaman-pengalaman yang menantang sekaligus memperkenalkan kekayaan budaya setempat. Mulai dari mempelajari seni bela diri Eskrima di Filipina, mengikuti balap kerbau di Indonesia, hingga mencicipi makanan khas yang tidak biasa, setiap perjalanan menghadirkan sisi budaya yang autentik dan jarang terlihat oleh wisatawan. Dengan memadukan petualangan, tantangan ekstrem, dan eksplorasi budaya, serial ini mengajak penonton melihat Asia dari sudut pandang yang berbeda.

Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Namun, di tengah-tengah segala kekonyolan itu, juga terjadi momen kebersamaan yang menyentuh hati, di mana tawa dan air mata berdampingan. programme.title: Cipung Abubu
programme.desc: Cipung Abubu

programme.title: CIPUNG ABUBU
programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. programme.title: Sunny Girl
programme.desc: Sunny Girl

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.title: PLENTIS KENTUS
programme.desc: PLENTIS KENTUS ADALAH SEBUAH ANIMASI ANAK-ANAK ASAL INDONESIA YANG POPULER DENGAN LAGU-LAGU CERIA DAN PENUH SEMANGAT. MEREKA DICIPTAKAN SEBAGAI BENTUK INOVASI DALAM INDUSTRI MUSIK ANAK-ANAK DI INDONESIA. PLENTIS DAN KENTUS ADALAH DUA SAHABAT KARIB YANG MASIH DUDUK DI BANGKU SEKOLAH DASAR. KEDUANYA MEMILIKI MIMPI BESAR UNTUK MENJADI PENYANYI TERKENAL. MEREKA SUKA BERNYANYI, MENCIPTAKAN LAGU, DAN TAMPIL DI BERBAGAI ACARA. PETUALANGAN MEREKA PENUH DENGAN KESERUAN, PERSAHABATAN, DAN TENTU SAJA, BANYAK SEKALI LAGU-LAGU YANG BISA MEMBUAT ANAK-ANAK IKUT BERNYANYI DAN BERGOYANG.

programme.title: BEDU DAN ADUL
programme.desc: BEDU DAN ADUL ADALAH SEBUAH SERIAL FILM ANIMASI 3D TENTANG PETUALANGAN ANAK-ANAK DI KAWASAN PINGGIRAN JAKARTA YANG MULTIKULTURAL. KARAKTER ANAK YANG SELALU INGIN TAHU MEMBUAT MEREKA INGIN SELALU BEREKSPLORASI HINGGA KADANG MENIMBULKAN KEHEBOHAN

programme.title: MADUN
programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. Ia tak tega mengekang madun yang mencintai bola. Namun untuk mewujudkan mimpinya. madun menghadapi banyak persaingan.

programme.title: COCOMELON IND
programme.desc: Animasi dan lagu 3d berbahasa indonesia, cocomelon menciptakan dunia yang berpusat pada pengalaman sehari-hari anak kecil. selain membantu anak-anak prasekolah mempelajari huruf, angka, suara binatang, warna, dan banyak lagi. video tersebut memberikan pelajaran kehidupan prososial. memberi orang tua kesempatan untuk mengajar dan bermain dengan anak-anak mereka saat mereka menonton bersama.

programme.title: PORORO AND TAYO SONGS
programme.desc: Tonton video musik untuk pororo, tayo, dan teman-temannya!

programme.title: NUMBERBLOCKS
programme.desc: Numberblocks adalah serial animasi pendidikan untuk anak-anak prasekolah yang mengajarkan konsep matematika melalui karakter blok angka yang hidup dan berpetualang. Setiap blok angka memiliki nilai numeriknya sendiri dan memiliki kepribadian yang unik. mereka bergabung dan berinteraksi satu sama lain untuk memecahkan masalah matematika sambil mengajarkan konsep dasar matematika seperti penjumlahan, pengurangan, perkalian, pembagian, dan konsep lainnya. Setiap episode dari "numberblocks" biasanya menampilkan cerita pendek di mana blok angka bekerja sama untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas atau menghadapi tantangan matematika. Melalui lagu-lagu, cerita-cerita yang menarik, dan visual yang cerah, serial ini bertujuan untuk memperkenalkan dan memperkuat pemahaman anak-anak tentang angka dan konsep matematika dasar dengan cara yang menyenangkan dan interaktif.

programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. programme.title: Microdrama + : Cinta Tak Untuk Dijual
programme.desc: Aldebaran, miliarder muda, menciptakan reality show untuk "membeli" cinta yang aman dari luka. programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Menyapa Indonesia Malam
programme.desc: Menyapa Indonesia Malam di Sin Po TV adalah program berita penutup hari yang merangkum dan menganalisis peristiwa penting sepanjang hari. Acara ini memberikan gambaran komprehensif tentang dinamika politik, ekonomi, sosial, dan budaya di Indonesia dan global. Setiap episode menyajikan berita utama, laporan eksklusif, dan analisis tajam dari para ahli, menggali latar belakang, implikasi, dan berbagai sudut pandang isu relevan. Program ini juga sering menyertakan segmen khusus tentang tren atau kisah inspiratif. Dengan penyampaian yang analitis dan mendalam, tujuannya adalah membekali pemirsa dengan pemahaman utuh dan menjadi referensi penting untuk insight lebih dalam hingga larut malam.

programme.title: Piala Presiden 2026
programme.desc: Turnamen pramusim paling bergengsi: PIALA PRESIDEN 2026! Segera digelar di dua stadion internasional, Stadion Si Jalak Harupat, Bandung, dan Stadion Gelora Bung Tomo, Surabaya, 25 Juli - 6 Agustus 2026. Memasuki edisi ke-8, PIALA PRESIDEN 2026 akan diikuti 8 klub dari 4 negara: Indonesia oleh Persib Bandung, Persebaya Surabaya, Persija Jakarta, Arema FC, dan PSMS Medan; Singapura oleh Tampines Rovers FC; Brunei Darussalam oleh DPMM FC; Tailan oleh Port FC, juara bertahan PIALA PRESIDEN 2025. Seluruh peserta siap berlaga dalam dua grup dengan total 16 pertandingan untuk memperebutkan gelar juara PIALA PRESIDEN 2026. Saksikan pertandingan Piala Presiden 2026 di SIN PO tv!

programme.title: Ruang Redaksi

programme.desc: Sebuah acara gelar wicara yang tayang setiap paginya dimana program ini akan mengangkat berita dari kalangan selebriti maupun non-selebriti secara mendalam dari berbagai sudut pandang dengan mengunggulkan koneksi pertemanan, sehingga pada saat mengulas isu yang tengah viral, pembawa acara akan langsung menghubungi sosok terkait dengan melakukan telepon atau panggilan video.

programme.title: Selebrita Heits
programme.desc: Sebuah acara televisi infotainment yang mengungkapkan fakta-fakta terkini seputar kehidupan selebritis.

programme.title: Big-Bang!
programme.desc: Terinspirasi dari Big Bang Theory, program terbaru BIG-BANG! hadir dengan menyuguhkan beragam konten berupa informasi terkini yang sedang trending dan viral.

programme.title: Enah Bikin Enak

programme.title: Jejak Si Gundul
programme.desc: Sebuah program petualangan yang mengekspose kearifan lokal lewat karakter kuat si Gundul yang serba bisa, suka menolong, dan tangguh. Si Gundul akan menjelajahi kekayaan budaya dan tradisi di berbagai wilayah Indonesia.

programme.title: Bocah Petualang
programme.desc: Program petualangan anak-anak dari beragam penjuru Nusantara yang memberikan pengenalan alam, kearifkan lokal dan budaya setempat sesuai tempat tinggal anak-anak.

programme.title: Indonesiaku
programme.desc: Program tayangan yang memberikan pendalaman tentang pemerataan pembangunan dan keadaan sosial masyarakat pelosok tanah air, Indonesiaku merupakan salah satu program yang telah memenangkan banyak penghargaan di berbagai penganugerahan di tanah air

programme.title: Redaksi

programme.title: Makan Receh

programme.title: Maman, Ne Me Laisse Pas M'Endormir
programme.desc: Juliette discovers that Joseph, her teenage son who she thought was fine, is actually very insecure and has a dangerous addiction to medical drugs. Determined to help him beat his addiction, she embarks upon a long and painful battle alongside him, without ever giving up hope of saving him.

programme.title: MAMAN, NE ME LAISSE PAS M'ENDORMIR
programme.desc: Diadaptasi dari kisah nyata dan buku karya Juliette Boudre, film ini menceritakan perjuangan seorang ibu untuk menyelamatkan putranya, Joseph, yang terjerumus dalam kecanduan obat-obatan resep seperti obat penenang dan opioid. Bersama keluarga, Juliette berupaya mencari berbagai cara untuk membantu Joseph pulih, mulai dari konsultasi medis hingga rehabilitasi. Namun perjalanan mereka dipenuhi tantangan, keputusasaan, dan harapan yang silih berganti dalam pertarungan panjang melawan kecanduan yang mengancam nyawa.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi
programme.desc: La Galerie Dior retraces the story of the famous French haute couture house, a tribute to the genius of Christian Dior and his successors. All about French lawyers' robes. L'Ingenieur Chevallier, the oldest French opticians, takes over Maison Bonnet, flagship of luxury eyewear. Wearing a bra as a top.

programme.title: La (Tres) Grande Evasion
programme.desc: Faced with tax evasion by multinational companies, political inaction increases suspicions of collusion among a population hit hard by the crisis. Increasingly taxed and victims of major inequalities, citizens have only one recourse and faint hope left: the ballot box.

programme.title: La (Tres) Grande Evasion
programme.desc: Faced with tax evasion by multinational companies, political inaction increases suspicions of collusion among a population hit hard by the crisis. Increasingly taxed and victims of major inequalities, citizens have only one recourse and faint hope left: the ballot box.

programme.title: LA (TRÈS) GRANDE ÉVASION

programme.title: L'Oeil Du Cyclone
programme.desc: The whole family gathers around to support Jade suffering from her first-ever broken heart.

programme.title: L'OEIL DU CYCLONE
programme.desc: L'OEIL DU CYCLONE mengikuti seorang perempuan yang berusaha menyeimbangkan peran sebagai ibu, karier, dan kehidupan pribadinya, menghadapi berbagai situasi lucu sekaligus menyentuh.

programme.desc: If the sun is as essential to the planet as it is to its inhabitants, it has become a lucrative market for solar protection manufacturers. programme.title: SOLEIL, UN BUSINESS BIEN DORÉ

Melalui investigasi mendalam, dokumenter ini menelusuri berbagai aspek bisnis sunscreen, mulai dari klaim pemasaran, tingkat perlindungan yang sebenarnya, hingga dampaknya terhadap kesehatan dan lingkungan. Film ini mempertanyakan apakah produk yang beredar benar-benar memberikan perlindungan sesuai yang dijanjikan, sekaligus menyoroti konsekuensi ekologis dari penggunaan produk tabir surya terhadap lautan dan ekosistemnya. Di tengah meningkatnya suhu global dan kesadaran akan kesehatan kulit, dokumenter ini mengungkap sisi tersembunyi dari sebuah bisnis yang terus berkembang pesat.

programme.title: Undercover Chef: Korea, Ep 10
programme.desc: Koki Kwon Sung Jun, Jung Ji Sun, dan Sam Kim telah dikenal luas di dunia kuliner Korea Selatan. Meski kini berstatus sebagai koki ternama, sudah lama sejak mereka terakhir bekerja sebagai juru masak junior di dapur. Untuk membuktikan bahwa kemampuan mereka masih tajam, ketiganya dikirim ke negara-negara yang menginspirasi masakan mereka dan menyamar sebagai staf dapur tingkat bawah. Tantangannya tidak berhenti di situ: mereka hanya memiliki lima hari untuk mengesankan atasan mereka dan membuat hidangan khas yang berhasil masuk ke menu restoran. Akankah pengalaman dan keterampilan mereka cukup untuk meraih kesuksesan atau justru mereka akan tumbang di bawah tekanan?

programme.title: Mr. Eo's Food World Tour, Ep 6

programme.title: Legend Of Kitchen Soldier, Ep 5
programme.desc: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier mengisahkan Kang Seong-jae, seorang pemuda dari keluarga sederhana yang memutuskan masuk militer setelah kematian ayahnya. Meski menjadi lulusan terbaik selama pelatihan, ia justru ditempatkan di bagian dapur karena pengalamannya membantu usaha food truck milik sang ayah. Kehidupannya berubah ketika sebuah sistem misterius layaknya permainan video muncul dan memberinya berbagai misi memasak. Setiap tantangan yang berhasil diselesaikan membuat kemampuan memasaknya berkembang pesat hingga ia menjadi sosok yang dihormati oleh rekan-rekan dan atasannya. Di balik kisah penuh humor dan semangat kebersamaan di barak militer, Seong-jae juga perlahan menemukan petunjuk tentang rahasia yang mungkin berkaitan dengan kematian ayahnya. Serial ini memadukan komedi, fantasi, dunia kuliner, dan kisah pertumbuhan diri dalam sebuah petualangan yang menghibur dan hangat.

programme.title: The Glorious My Revenge

programme.title: Cafe Midnight
programme.desc: Yoon pergi mencari pengantin prianya, Taeyoung, yang tidak muncul di hari pernikahan. Secara kebetulan, ia tiba di sebuah tempat aneh bernama 'Cafe Midnight' dan menemukan Taeyoung yang berusia muda dari masa lalu.

programme.title: Only God Knows Everything
programme.desc: Usai ditahbiskan, Pastor Do-woon mendengar pengakuan yang menguak hilangnya sang ibu 13 tahun lalu. Terbelenggu rahasia suci dan dendam, ia memilih memburu kebenaran.

programme.title: You Will Die In 6 Hours
programme.desc: Jun Woo memperingatkan Jeong Yun tentang pembunuhan yang akan menimpanya. Dengan rasa skeptis, ia mulai menyelidiki dan menemukan keterkaitan Jun Woo dengan serangkaian pembunuhan. Ia pun berpacu dengan waktu untuk mengetahui apakah Jun Woo melindunginya atau justru menipunya sebelum kematian yang telah diramalkan itu terjadi.

programme.title: The Silenced
programme.desc: Seorang gadis sakit bernama Ju-ran pindah ke sekolah asrama sanatorium baru untuk memulihkan kesehatannya. Namun, ia menemukan bahwa para siswa menghilang dan memperhatikan perubahan abnormal yang terjadi pada tubuhnya. Ia mencoba mengungkap rahasia apa yang tersembunyi di baliknya.

programme.title: Innocence (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pengacara ternama mengungkap konspirasi sebuah desa kecil saat membela ibunya yang diasingkan karena menderita penyakit Alzheimer dan dituduh membunuh para pelayat di pemakaman suaminya.

programme.title: Hello Ghost (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Upaya bunuh diri seorang pria yang gagal membuatnya dapat melihat hantu, yang kemudian terus mengikutinya ke mana pun. Kini terserah padanya untuk memenuhi keinginan mereka agar mereka pergi.

programme.title: Smugglers (TVN Movies)

programme.desc: Facing unemployment and his girlfriend's rejection, writer Eddie Morra is sure that he has no future. That all changes when an old friend gives him a drug that produces enhanced mental acuity. Stoked on the untested chemical, Eddie rises to the top of the financial world and attracts the attention of a tycoon who intends to use him to make a fortune. But terrible side effects and a dwindling supply threaten to collapse Eddie's house of cards.

programme.title: Arlington Road [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Carter (Whoopi Goldberg) needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson (Sissy Spacek), but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband (Dwight Schultz) insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Before I Go To Sleep [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergrass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: The Heart Of Me [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Set in 1930s London with two sisters, Madeleine married to Rickie, and Dinah, who falls in love with him. Rickie and Dinah begin an affair.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: When rookie cop Megan Turner (Jamie Lee Curtis) kills a convenience store robber, she does not notice when psychopathic commodities trader Eugene Hunt (Ron Silver) takes the dead man's gun. With no weapon at the crime scene, the police hold Turner accountable for killing an unarmed man. Meanwhile, Hunt uses the stolen weapon to go on a killing spree. Turner teams up with detective Nick Mann (Clancy Brown) to clear her name and catch the killer. An unexpected romance complicates matters.

programme.title: Backtrack
programme.desc: While fixing a flat tire, artist Anne Benton (Jodie Foster) sees a mob killing. She reports the murder to the local police, but they are unable to protect her from Mafia don Lino Avoca (Vincent Price), who orders hitman Milo (Dennis Hopper) to track her down and kill her. Anne changes her identity, moves to Seattle and builds a new life, while Milo, preparing for his mission, becomes increasingly obsessed with her. When he finally finds Anne, Milo needs to decide what his next move will be.

Her husband died after only a few years of marriage, and ever since she's been managing his three spoiled daughters, their cranky Uncle Poppy (Jack Palance) and the family business. In between planning Poppy's upcoming 100th birthday and commiserating with her brother-in-law, Zeb (Peter Riegert), she reconnects with her old sweetheart, Will (Peter Fonda), to see what might have been.

programme.title: Wedding March 3: Here Comes the Bride
programme.desc: It's a full Valentine's Day weekend at the Inn when Olivia and Mick host Mick's sister and her finance, Mick's daughter and her boyfriend, and Olivia's mother and her boyfriend. Things get chaotic when Mick's sister decides to have her wedding at the Inn that weekend and Mick's daughter announces plans to drop out of college. Stars Jack Wagner and Josie Bissett.

programme.title: A Ring by Spring
programme.desc: A woman ponders her future when a fortuneteller predicts a lifetime of loneliness if she does not wed soon.

programme.title: Chesapeake Shores
programme.desc: As Kevin remains missing, Mick, Nell and the rest of the O'Brien family nervously wait for more news, while Abby goes to New York to fight for custody of her daughters. Despite Leigh's stubborn efforts, Trace continues to hide from his past...

programme.title: Good Witch
programme.desc: Like mother, like daughter! The enchanting Cassie Nightingale is back with daughter Grace by her side and together their spellbinding charm is no match for Middleton's newest neighbors.

programme.title: Good Witch
programme.desc: As Middleton's Heritage Festival gets everyone in town talking, Cassie is back to her bewitching ways as she welcomes a scared young woman to the Grey House, only to find out she's being followed.

programme.title: Pumpkin Everything
programme.desc: Amy Fox left her hometown of Autumnsboro, New Hampshire to chase her dream of becoming a novelist. She did so even when Tom Adams, her grandfather who loved her dearly, was not supportive.

programme.title: Candles on Bay Street
programme.desc: Veterinarian Sam (Eion Bailey) leads a simple, happy life with his wife, Lydia (Annabeth Gish), in the Maine town where he grew up. But when Dee-Dee (Alicia Silverstone), the girl who was his adolescent obsession, returns home a single mother after being gone for years, Sam struggles as his old feelings return. Dee-Dee opens a candle-making workshop, and Sam and Lydia cautiously befriend her young son, Trooper (Matthew Knight) -- wondering about Dee-Dee's intentions all the while.

programme.title: To Dance with the White Dog
programme.desc: Shortly after celebrating 50 years of marriage, elderly farmer Sam Peek (Hume Cronyn) loses his wife, Cora (Jessica Tandy), to a heart attack. Though overwhelmed with grief, Sam stubbornly insists that he continue to tend to his orchards, refusing to entertain his family's suggestions that he slow down. But when Sam cautiously reveals that he believes Cora has returned in the form of an elusive white dog, his adult children and grandson Bobby (Harley Cross) grow concerned about his sanity.

programme.title: Breathing Lessons
programme.desc: When the husband of their friend Serena (Joyce Van Patten) dies, Ira (James Garner) and Maggie Moran (Joanne Woodward), an older married couple, make an event out of their day's travel to the funeral. Examining life and marriage on their journey, the couple of 29 years remains as in love today as when they first met -- despite being near opposites in personality. However, their love and respect for one another cut through all the differences between them.

programme.title: Missing Pieces
programme.desc: A suspense-filled movie about a father looking for answers after the mysterious death of his estranged son. Twelve years have passed since a family tragedy drove father and son apart. Police in the remote Mexican village where Scott died believe...

programme.title: The Boys Next Door
programme.desc: Kind-hearted social worker Jack Palmer (Tony Goldwyn) feels guilty about not spending enough time with his wife (Mare Winningham) due to the pressures of his job taking care of four developmentally disabled men: obsessive-compulsive Norman (Nathan Lane), bipolar Arnold (Michael Jeter), childlike Lucien (Courtney B. Vance) and schizophrenic Barry (Robert Sean Leonard). When Jack announces his decision to leave his job, his four charges react quite unexpectedly to the news.

programme.title: Sweet Pecan Summer
programme.desc: Amanda (Christine Ko, "Tigertail," "Hawaii Five-0") works in product development at a large cosmetics company. She loves what she does but is starting to feel like she can't implement her best ideas since the company plays it safe...

programme.title: Summer in the Vineyard
programme.desc: In the sequel to Autumn in the Vineyard, Frankie Baudouin and Nate DeLuca are now a couple and are gearing up for Summer Fest, the town's largest event. They can't wait to reveal their new wine and put the vineyard on the map. Meanwhile, Nate's brother Marco has shocked everyone, especially their mother, by buying the town B&B, while his high school crush Lexi's return to town is further complicating matters.

programme.title: Summer Love
programme.desc: Maya Sulliway is a struggling single mom who's studying to become an accountant. When her young daughter goes off to sleepaway camp, Maya accepts a summer internship at Kizzmit, a tech company known for developing a popular social app, in order to receive college credit. Stars Rachael Leigh Cook, Lucas Bryant and Travis Milne.

programme.title: Summer in the City
programme.desc: When a small town woman with Midwestern charm is given a big promotion managing a store in the Big Apple, she tries to adopt a big city personality and it leads to disastrous results. Realizing it's better to be true to herself, she lets her personality shine and it becomes the secret to her success in work and in love. Stars Julianna Guill, Marc Bendavid, Vivica A. Fox and Marla Sokoloff.

programme.title: A Summer to Remember
programme.desc: When an ambitious doctor books an overdue vacation for some much needed R&R and bonding with her teenage daughter, the time away will have her questioning if this island holds the promise of something more than the life she has waiting backhome. Stars Catherine Bell, Cameron Mathison.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Mouse Trap
programme.desc: Stuck working the late shift at the amusement park arcade, Alex receives a surprise visit from her friends on her 21st birthday. However, their night of fun soon turns into a fight for survival when a killer dressed as Mickey Mouse crashes the party.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: CAT 8
programme.desc: A research program once abandoned by the best solar physicist when the Pentagon wanted to put it to military use, has been resumed by his former deputy.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Before The Devil Knows You're Dead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Andy needs some quick cash gets his younger brother into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit crimes.

programme.title: The Lost Princess
programme.desc: A billionaire gets transported to a bloody battle that leads him to an old castle in Morocco. He soon meets Hanna, who shares the tragic tale of her mother's forced marriage to a Saudi prince, and her secret love affair with a castle caretaker.

programme.title: The Fix
programme.desc: When a troubled model takes a new drug at a party, she suffers a shocking transformation. Pursued by authorities and a dangerous gang, she hunts for a 'fix' to reverse these effects, only to discover her mutations could save the human race.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Brother Orange
programme.desc: In 2014, BuzzFeed writer Matt Stopera's phone was stolen from a bar in New York City. A year later, photos of storefronts and a man next to an orange tree mysteriously appeared in his iPhoto stream. Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: Dr Lehman and his assistant Imogene join forces to avert a looming disaster. They strive to divert a meteor hurtling towards Earth, determined to save humanity from impending doom.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Curse of Chucky
programme.desc: Out for revenge, Chucky (Brad Dourif) the killer doll infiltrates the family of a woman, her sister and her young niece.

programme.title: Halloween II
programme.desc: After failing to kill stubborn survivor Laurie (Jamie Lee Curtis) and taking a bullet or six from former psychiatrist Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), Michael Myers (Jonathan Prince) has followed Laurie to the Haddonfield Memorial Hospital, where she's been admitted for Myers' attempt on her life. The institution proves to be particularly suited to serial killers, however, as Myers cuts, stabs and slashes his way through hospital staff to reach his favorite victim.

programme.title: Halloween III: Season of the Witch
programme.desc: Hospital emergency room Dr. Daniel "Dan" Challis (Tom Atkins) and Ellie Grimbridge (Stacey Nelkin), the daughter of a murder victim, uncover a terrible plot by small-town mask maker Conal Cochran (Dan O'Herlihy), a madman who's planning a Halloween mass murder utilizing an ancient Celtic ritual. The ritual involves a boulder stolen from Stonehenge, the use of Silver Shamrock masks and a triggering device contained in a television commercial -- all designed to kill millions of children.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Unleashed
programme.desc: Crime boss Bart raises orphan Danny with no knowledge of anything other than how to fight, using him as an enforcer when debts must be collected. Planning to enter Danny into a fight tournament and retire with the prize money, Bart disappears after a deadly drive-by shooting. Danny flees and takes shelter with piano tuner Sam. Away from Bart's abusive control, Danny learns how to live like a human and begins investigating his past.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Unleashed

programme.title: Mercury Rising
programme.desc: "Mercury Rising" stars Bruce Willis as Art Jeffries, a renegade FBI agent who combats ruthless federal agents to protect Simon (Miko Hughes), a 9-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new unbreakable code. He can read MERCURY, the most advanced encryption code yet created, as easily as other kids read English. This ability renders the new billion-dollar secret code vulnerable, especially if enemies of the United States should learn of Simon's abilities and capture him.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Street Fighter
programme.desc: Gen. Bison (Raul Julia), the evil dictator of Shadaloo, captures a busload of relief workers and holds them for ransom. Col. Guile (Jean-Claude Van Damme) leads an international strike force to invade Shadaloo and rescue the hostages. Along the way, Guile recruits Chun-Li (Ming-Na Wen), a reporter and martial-arts expert whose father was killed by Bison years ago, two young con men (Damian Chapa, Byron Mann) and a sumo wrestler (Peter Navy Tuiasosopo).

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.desc: College freshman Whittier (Anne Judson-Yager) and her friend Monica (Faune A. Chambers) make the Cal State cheerleading squad, but can't stand its snobbish leader, Tina (Bree Turner). They resolve to form their own team, pulling together a collection of geeky art students and hippie bleeding hearts whose extracurricular programs were cut for budgetary reasons. Through teamwork, they challenge the official squad's right to represent the school at the upcoming cheerleading championship.

programme.title: Bring It On: All or Nothing
programme.desc: When her father gets laid off, prom queen shoo-in Britney Allen (Hayden Panettiere) has to drop out and transfer to her ritzy high school's underfunded crosstown rival. At her new school, Britney is recruited for the cheerleading squad by its tough captain, Camille (Solange Knowles). As Britney struggles to win the respect of her new peers, they prepare to face off against the squad at her old school for a chance to dance back-up for Rihanna (Rihanna) in her next music video.

programme.title: Bring It On: In It to Win It
programme.desc: A high-school senior (Ashley Benson) falls for a fellow cheerleader (Michael Copon), not realizing that he is on a rival squad.

programme.title: Bring It On: Fight to the Finish
programme.desc: When her mother falls for a wealthy man, Lina Cruz (Christina Milian) must move in with her new stepfather and transfer from a run-down public high school to an exclusive prep school, where she struggles to fit in with her affluent new peers. After snooty cheerleading captain Avery (Rachele Brooke Smith) blocks Lina from varsity, Lina recruits her best friends from her old school to help her whip the pathetic junior varsity cheerleading squad -- the Sea Lions -- into fighting shape.

programme.title: Bring It On: Worldwide #Cheersmack
programme.desc: Destiny, captain of three-time national champion cheerleading squad The Rebels, accepts a challenge from an edgy new team called The Truth. An Internet celebrity, known as the Cheer Goddess, organizes the virtual battle.

programme.title: The Best Man
programme.desc: A writer heads to New York to be the best man at a friend's wedding, where he meets up with an old flame.

programme.title: The Muse
programme.desc: Screenwriter Steven Phillips (Albert Brooks) seemingly has it all, including an Academy Award for his latest script. But he's hit an artistic dry patch, so his writer friend Jack Warrick (Jeff Bridges) recommends the services of Sarah Little (Sharon Stone), a woman he swears is a veritable muse. Steven takes her on and is suddenly more inspired to create. Her services, however, come at a very steep price and Steven becomes suspicious about who Sarah really is and what she wants.

programme.title: The Story of Us
programme.desc: After 15 years of marriage, Katie (Michelle Pfeiffer) and her husband, Ben (Bruce Willis), have grown apart. While they keep up the facade of having a contented marriage, mostly to not worry their children, they aren't happy together and argue frequently. While the kids are away at camp, Katie and Ben decide to separate and try to reassess their relationship to see if they should stay together or split up for good. Can they find enough that's positive in their marriage to keep it going?

programme.title: Sid the Science Kid

With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Operation Fortune: Ruse de guerre
programme.desc: Elite spy Orson Fortune must track down and stop the sale of a deadly new weapons technology wielded by billionaire arms broker Greg Simmonds. Reluctantly teamed up with some of the world's best operatives, Fortune and his crew recruit Hollywood's biggest movie star, Danny Francesco, to help them on their globe-trotting mission to save the world.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Unfulfilled and facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts a $1 million offer to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Things take a wildly unexpected turn when a CIA operative recruits Cage for an unusual mission. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: The Spy Who Dumped Me
programme.desc: Best friends Audrey and Morgan are going about their humdrum lives in Los Angeles -- until Audrey's ex-boyfriend suddenly shows up with a team of deadly assassins on his trail. Unexpectedly thrust into an international conspiracy, the gals soon find themselves dodging killers and a suspicious British agent while hatching a plan to save the world.

programme.title: Red
programme.desc: After surviving an assault from a squad of hit men, retired CIA agent Frank Moses (Bruce Willis) reassembles his old team for an all-out war. Frank reunites with old Joe (Morgan Freeman), crazy Marvin (John Malkovich) and wily Victoria (Helen Mirren) to uncover a massive conspiracy that threatens their lives. Only their expert training will allow them to survive a near-impossible mission -- breaking into CIA headquarters.

programme.title: Red 2

With assassins hot on their trail, Frank and his team set out to find the one scientist (Anthony Hopkins) who can unravel the mystery of Nightshade and help them save themselves -- and the world.

programme.title: Five Feet Apart
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Stella spends most of her time in the hospital as a cystic fibrosis patient. Her life is full of routines, boundaries and self-control -- all of which get put to the test when she meets Will, an impossibly charming teen who has the same illness. There's an instant flirtation, though restrictions dictate that they must maintain a safe distance between them. As their connection intensifies, so does the temptation to throw the rules out the window and embrace that attraction.

Adam Lerner has always tried to take good care of his health, so it comes as a cruel surprise when he learns that he has malignant tumors along his spine. His doctor gives him a 50/50 chance of survival, but Adam tries to remain upbeat, though his mother and his friend Kyle, react badly to the news. Adam starts seeing a therapist, but their relationship threatens to cross the boundary between doctor and patient.

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: Greta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Greta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Greta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Greta's first album.

programme.title: Dirty Dancing
programme.desc: Baby (Jennifer Grey) is one listless summer away from the Peace Corps. Hoping to enjoy her youth while it lasts, she's disappointed when her summer plans deposit her at a sleepy resort in the Catskills with her parents. Her luck turns around, however, when the resort's dance instructor, Johnny (Patrick Swayze), enlists Baby as his new partner, and the two fall in love. Baby's father forbids her from seeing Johnny, but she's determined to help him perform the last big dance of the summer.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

She insists it's no biggie, but when she tries to resume practice, the normally fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! At the local snow lodge's Snowboard Meet, ace snowboarder Mia, trying to raise money for a new Heartlake City animal shelter, enters the fiercest race of all – the Boardercross. Then, while practicing, she has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no big deal, but once she heals and tries to resume practice, the usually fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! With the help of her Friends, she tries hard to overcome her fear, but her nightmarish visions of snowboard monsters and jeering snowmen have her shaking in her bed.
